# jupiterone_control_tests (Data Source)

The control tests belonging to a control, including their evaluation results.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every control test attached to a control, with its evaluation results.
data "jupiterone_control_tests" "mfa" {
  control_id = jupiterone_control.mfa.id
}

# Surface tests that ran but had nothing to evaluate. These read as passing
# without proving anything, so they are worth reviewing separately from failures.
output "tests_without_data" {
  value = [
    for t in data.jupiterone_control_tests.mfa.control_tests : t.name
    if length([for q in t.queries : q if q.effective == false]) > 0
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `control_id` (String) The control whose tests should be returned.

### Read-Only

- `control_tests` (Attributes List) The control tests belonging to the control. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--control_tests))
- `id` (String) A generated identifier for this result set.

<a id="nestedatt--control_tests"></a>
### Nested Schema for `control_tests`

Read-Only:

- `control_id` (String) The control this test belongs to.
- `description` (String) Description of the control test.
- `id` (String) The ID of the control test.
- `last_evaluated_on` (Number) When the control test was last evaluated, as epoch milliseconds.
- `name` (String) The name of the control test.
- `queries` (Attributes List) The queries that make up this control test, with their evaluation results. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--control_tests--queries))
- `referenced_rule_id` (String) The ID of the rule that evaluates this control test.
- `resource_group_id` (String) The resource group the control test is scoped to.
- `status` (String) The evaluated status of the control test, PASS or FAIL.

<a id="nestedatt--control_tests--queries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `control_tests.queries`

Read-Only:

- `effective` (Boolean) Whether the query returned usable data when it was last evaluated.
- `name` (String) The name of the query.
- `query` (String) The J1QL query.
- `record_count` (Number) How many records the query returned when it was last evaluated.
- `results_are` (String) Whether results indicate GOOD or BAD compliance.
- `status` (String) The evaluated status of this query, PASS or FAIL.
